title: finally release a FREE Demo for my desktop companion idle shooter!
author: justsaymoo
selftext:
Built a desktop companion shooter using AI as my main dev tool – free demo is live

Every click or keypress anywhere on your PC fires a shot in-game. The game lives at the bottom of your screen while you work or browse.

Used Claude for code and architecture, image generators for base assets (all manually reworked). \~700 hours total.

  
woul be thxfull for any feedback how it plays!

[try it here!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5001830/FIRE_HOLD_REPEAT_Demo/?beta=0)  enjoy <3
